title: First Draft – Now We Know What Stands Between Trump’s U.S. and Total Collapse: A Cabinet of Idiots
author: Prem Thakker
content:
_🚨 BREAKING: The International Court of Justice
[ruled](https://apnews.com/article/rohingya-myanmar-genocide-court-
icj-30df77b12bf3f911f1100e77ebe3973a) that Myanmar committed genocide against
the Rohingya in a major decision marking the first time a state - rather than
an individual - has been found responsible for violating the 1948 Genocide
Convention. The case has been [closely watched for
signs](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/top-un-court-ruling-myanmar-
genocide-be-watched-clues-gaza-2026-11-17/) about how the ICJ could rule in
the ongoing genocide case against Israel over the atrocities committed in
Gaza. Watch your inbox for more from **Zeteo** on Thursday's landmark ruling
later today. _

Good morning, friends! **Prem** here, hoping Substack isn't going through its
own outage and you're actually receiving my email!

In today's **' First Draft,'** we'll discuss how the systems undergirding U.S.
society are teetering on the brink of collapse, and being (barely) held up
_despite_ the people in charge, not _because_ of them. Read on for the insane
things that our dear Cabinet officials have said on live television ostensibly
to calm us down, and stay for reaction from Reps. **Thomas Massie** and
**Jamie Raskin**.

We'll also consider the latest bit of bullshit from **Elon Musk** , who after
spending $500 million and seeing the Republicans shellacked in the midterms
anyway, is suddenly seeing the light and pretending not to be MAGA. There's
more on the Iran war too. Let's read in.

Microsoft. Apple. JPMorgan Chase. United Airlines. The Federal Aviation
Administration and the entire American airspace. The National Security Agency.

These and so many more organizations, companies, and government bodies have
faced system outages and breaches in recent days.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Such an explosion of failures and interruptions has alarmed Americans
nationwide, and people worldwide. The public is wondering: Should we take out
hard cash? Get in weeks' worth of canned food? Arrange for some gold bars and
other currency to barter with after the possible apocalypse?

It's a tense moment. In times like these, we look to our leaders for guidance,
assurance, and support - anything to calm fears and provide accurate and
reliable information.

Now, from the officials in charge of protecting the homeland and managing
transportation, we are getting spitballed theories and head-scratching
conjectures.

It started last Friday.
